== Summary ==
Slip “Transmission Terminated” cut unchanged from page 6 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 211, 1102, 495)). Version [[Transmission Terminated (V)#Source formats|Transmission Terminated (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
